description: Tessa's return to Santa Helena turns grief into a secret campaign against Montoya's rule. Across duels, kidnappings, conspiracies and fights over land and justice, the Queen's greatest difficulty is often protecting people without exposing the woman behind the mask.

s01e01.description: After learning that her father has been murdered, Tessa returns from Madrid to Spanish California and embraces a masked identity to defend the people suffering under Montoya's rule.

s01e02.description: Wounded while investigating vanished prisoners, the Queen discovers Montoya is using captives as slave labor in a secret gold mine.

s01e03.description: An epidemic sweeps the region and Grisham steals Dr. Helm's medicine, forcing Tessa to clear the Queen's name while recovering the missing treatment.

s01e04.description: An attempted shooting appears to target a local don, but the Queen discovers Dr. Helm is the real victim and that the assassin has found a willing partner in Montoya.

s01e05.description: Tessa's glimpse of a murder makes her the crucial witness in a case Montoya hopes to exploit, while the accused man's formidable mother threatens her if she testifies.

s01e06.description: Tessa's former lover arrives in Santa Helena as a celebrated swordsman, only for her to discover Montoya has hired him to kill the Queen.

s01e07.description: A young outlaw gang disrupts tax payments and gives Montoya an excuse to seize ranches, leaving the Queen to expose who is really behind the raids.

s01e08.description: Tessa protects a deserter who knows something about her father's murder while a young shaman seeks a sacred gold mask stolen from his father's grave.

s01e09.description: Montoya turns a captured Queen impostor into a weapon, encouraging new robberies so the real vigilante will lose the people's trust.

s01e10.description: After rescuing a don's son from the bandit known as the Serpent, the Queen clashes with Dr. Helm over treating the outlaw and pursues his gang after a village is attacked.

s01e11.description: A secret pact involving Tessa's father and two other dons leads to a divided treasure map, and Grisham's discovery sends the Queen racing to recover the hidden fortune first.

s01e12.description: An ambitious royal emissary arrives determined to take the Queen's head, threatening both her and Montoya as he schemes for the King's favor and local command.

s01e13.description: A man from Vera's past kidnaps her and demands more than ransom, forcing the Queen to protect Vera, her husband's gold and a secret that could ruin her.

s01e14.description: Tessa's uncle arrives from Spain seeking vengeance for his brother, but Montoya manipulates the evidence and Tessa must stop her last close relative from killing an innocent man.

s01e15.description: An Englishwoman and two enslaved companions flee an abusive husband into Santa Helena, where a fabricated kidnapping claim and Dr. Helm's past complicate the Queen's attempt to protect them.

s01e16.description: With Montoya away, an old enemy of Grisham seizes Santa Helena and takes the dons hostage, prompting the Queen to organize their wives into an unlikely rescue force.

s01e17.description: Marta's former lover returns and is arrested after his companion commits robbery and murder, leaving Montoya to offer freedom in exchange for an assassination.

s01e18.description: A dying stranger accuses a respected family of lies and murder, and the Queen follows the clues to a son whose own parents suddenly seem eager to condemn him.

s01e19.description: Two traveling con men promise Montoya they can capture the Queen for a reward, but after she saves one of them they are pulled into helping her survive Montoya's lethal trap.

s01e20.description: A samurai apprentice arrives seeking vengeance for his murdered master, and Montoya manipulates his grief into a confrontation with the Queen.

s01e21.description: An earthquake traps the Queen and Grisham together in an abandoned mine, forcing bitter enemies to cooperate as their air runs out.

s01e22.description: After Grisham injures Vera and frames the Queen, Montoya imposes martial law and launches his strongest attempt yet to destroy Santa Helena's masked protector.
